verdicts.reason: The two candidates share the same broken layout. The white logo bar stops short of the right edge, so it sits off-centre with a navy strip beside it. Body copy is jammed right under the headline with no divider spacing. The orange divider collides with the top of the CTA button, and the bottom quarter of the canvas is empty. A is worse because its logo is blown up to nearly fill the bar, cramped against the bar's edges. B keeps the logo small and centred, closer to the original, though perhaps a bit undersized.
